name: Rufino Osteria
recommendation: It’s a small (thus reservation recommended) basement on a corner just after the bridge onto Christianshavn and it’s one of my absolute favorite Italian places. They have a few small tables and one large communal table in the middle. The service is slow but thorough, the Italian food is fantastic, though a bit pricey, their wine selection isn’t large but very high quality. They will pour you rare grappa that will always impress. Do not skip dessert, it is always worthwhile here.
